name: JPY Command Center
treasury: Ministry of Finance (MoF) — Financial Bureau (JGB issuance, treasury funds)
monetary_sovereignty: full (JPY issuer, floating FX, domestic-currency debt; MoF FX intervention possible)
framework: Floor system with excess reserves ~28x required: Complementary Deposit Facility (IOER) at the policy rate = floor; Complementary Lending Facility (basic loan rate) = ceiling at policy + 25 bp; uncollateralized overnight call rate target 'around 1.0%' since 2026-06-17 (MPM 2026-06-16, 7-1). QT: monthly JGB purchases stepping down ~0.2 tn per quarter to ~2.0 tn from April 2027 (plan MPM 2026-06-16, no interim review). TONA normally trades 2-3 bp BELOW IOER (non-IOER institutions lend below the floor) — that is structure, not friction.

units.accounts: JPY thousand (BoJ Accounts) — converted to 100 million at ingest; magnitude guard: total assets must be 5e14–9e14 yen

lineage.origin: JPY Liquidity Command Center v5 (Netlify Function + FRED monthly + frankfurter + Yahoo; BoJ/CAB/gov deposits/TONAR/TIBOR/JGB tenors/fiscal = SEED)
rescued: composite idea 'BoJ assets − government deposits' (now real from BoJ Accounts every 10 days)
metric wish-list: CAB, excess reserves, TONA, term call rates, JGB curve by tenor, fiscal factors — all now from primary daily sources
per-metric provenance badge → Desk Standard states
discarded: FRED as a JPY source (monthly, lagged)

balance_sheet_phase.formula: NIMBLE_SUPPORT if jgb_purchases_vs_plan_pct > +20% or pooled_collateral_ops rising with jgb_10y_5d_change ≥ WATCH; QT if purchases within ±20% of plan and holdings falling; STEADY otherwise

jgb_purchases_month_to_date.note: policy-driven QT pace: compare with calendar.jgb_purchase_plan

jgb_purchases_vs_plan_pct.note: projected = month-to-date scaled by business days; > +20% = nimble support (yield spike), < −20% = faster QT than announced

holdings_vs_expected_path.formula: jgb_holdings − interpolated expected path (519.9 tn 2026-08-31 → ~480 tn 2027-03-31)
holdings_vs_expected_path.note: INFORMATIONAL: run-off is mechanical (redemption calendar); not a policy flag (CodeWord)

primary_absolute.origin: DESK PROPOSAL — the BoJ publishes no estimate of banks' reserve demand; ratio 28.5x on 2026-09-07 so these are informational for years. Reviewers: point to any BoJ paper quantifying reserve demand under the normalisation
primary_absolute.review_rule: re-check at every MPM that touches the balance-sheet plan and at every BoJ Review of Monetary Policy

secondary_level_anchor.origin: DESK PROPOSAL (Qwen/Kimi): operational cushion levels under passive QT; not a BoJ figure; review at every MPM

reserves.percentile_note: no percentile on the LEVEL (structural decline under QT); percentiles on cab_dod, cab_20d_change since 2024-08-01 (post-YCC/QT window) or 750d, whichever shorter

cab_dod.note: daily reserve impulse — fiscal days and JGB settlement days dominate; informational unless price confirms

clf_loans_daily.origin: penalty-rate facility; any use = flag (analogue of Advances > 0)

slf_daily.note: SLF is used operationally (CTD squeezes, futures delivery ~10th) — JGB_COLLATERAL_SQUEEZE only with rates.gc_minus_ioer_bps ≥ 3 persistent (DeepSeek/CodeWord)

Government deposits at the BoJ are small (MoF manages cash with T-Bills) and only ten-day.

treasury_funds_daily.label: Treasury funds and others — daily (BoJ sign: minus = net receipt = drain)

bid_to_cover_superlong.note: weak demand gauge for the QT_STRESS overlay

auction_tail_superlong_bp.note: dealer concession gauge; wide tail + low bid-to-cover = super-long stress (May-2025 20Y auction as reference event)

thresholds.score_cap_note: fiscal score contributes at most ±1.5 of the ±2 range; weight lowered to 0.20 in v0.2 (fiscal flows do not transmit to rates at 28x excess — CodeWord/Gemini/DeepSeek)

auction_tail_superlong_bp.calibration: provisional absolute anchors (3/6/12 bp) — recalibrate after 26 weeks of result pages

banking.title: 3 · Banking transmission — loans, deposits, money stock, BoJ credit programmes
banking.equivalence_note: Monthly only (loans ~8th, money stock ~2nd week); transmission read as levels + growth, plus BoJ lending programmes every ten days.

loans_total.label: Loans and discounts — major + regional + shinkin banks (avg outstanding)

deposits_total.label: Deposits and CDs — city + regional + shinkin

loan_support_program.id: Annex 2: Fund-Provisioning Measure to Stimulate Bank Lending

cab_by_sector.label: Excess reserves: foreign banks vs all reserve-requirement institutions

foreign_banks_excess_share.note: funding canary: a falling share while TRR/TONA firm = foreign banks short of yen (Gemini/CodeWord)

rates.title: 4 · Rates and money market — TONA vs the corridor, term call, JGB curve
rates.equivalence_note: TONA daily (avg/high/low/volume), collateralized and term call daily, full JGB curve daily from the MoF. Floor system: TONA sits 2-3 bp BELOW IOER by construction.

tona.label: TONA — uncollateralized O/N call, average
tona.note: BoJ Time-Series API publishes call rates with a 2-business-day lag (verified 2026-09-08 22:22 JST: last value 09-04); the desk splices the BoJ call-market summary (fcall, T-1) for the latest sessions until the API catches up

collateralized_on.label: Collateralized O/N call (GC-like)
collateralized_on.note: BoJ collateralized call (0.93) is thin; the GC benchmark is the JSDA Tokyo Repo Rate

call_1m.note: thin: may be blank on many days → stale allowed 10 sessions

tona_minus_policy_bps.note: reference only (policy_rate = basic_loan_rate − 0.25); equals tona_minus_ioer while IOER = target

band_position.note: negative by construction in a floor system; > 0 = trading above the floor; 1 = at the ceiling

collateralized_minus_uncollateralized_bp.note: display only from v0.2 (thin BoJ collateralized call); use gc_minus_tona_bps

call_1m_minus_policy_bps.note: embeds hike expectations ahead of MPMs — percentile capped at WATCH, absolute binding (AUD BBSW rule)

jgb_10y_5d_change_bps.note: 'rapid rise' trigger for BoJ nimble purchases

friction_confirmed.formula: tona_minus_ioer_bps ≥ 0 for 3 consecutive sessions OR tona_high_minus_ioer_bps ≥ 5 for 3 consecutive sessions

tona_minus_ioer_bps.note: PRIMARY stress spread (anchored to the floor rate, not the derived policy_rate — CodeWord); structural −2/−3 bp: non-eligible institutions (investment trusts, insurers, CCPs, public FIs) lend below IOER via tanshi (BoJ b37); 2026-09-07 = −2.3

gc_minus_ioer_bps.note: GC repo vs floor: 0 on 2026-09-08; ≥ +3 persistent = collateral/cash squeeze

gc_minus_tona_bps.note: +2.3 on 2026-09-08 (GC at the floor, call below it) — normal; widening = collateral demand

trr_3m_minus_ioer_bps.note: term repo premium; embeds hike expectations → percentile capped at WATCH

curve_40y_30y_bps.note: display: ~0 on 2026-09-07 (flat = distortion, not stress — CodeWord)

floor_leak.note: drift toward zero = floor failing (benign discount is −2…−8) — CodeWord/Kimi

tona_high_minus_ioer_bps.note: one-day spikes at month/quarter end are excluded

call_1m_minus_policy_bps.rule: absolute binding for STRESS/CRISIS; percentile caps at WATCH (embeds hike expectations)

secondary_absolute.origin: floor system: TONA −2/−3 bp vs IOER normal (non-eligible lenders); down to −8 still benign; ≤ −15 persistent = FLOOR_LEAK; 0 = at the floor; +25 = ceiling (basic loan rate)

tona_minus_ioer_bps.rule: absolute is binding for STRESS/CRISIS; percentile alone caps at WATCH

trr_3m_minus_ioer_bps.rule: absolute binding; percentile caps at WATCH

curve_20y_10y_bps.note: primary QT-supply stress gauge (majority of reviewers)

regime.weights_note: v0.2: rates raised to 0.35 (DeepSeek), fiscal lowered to 0.20 (Gemini/CodeWord: fiscal flows do not transmit to rates at 28x excess; Perplexity/Qwen kept 0.25) — median of the six. Recalibrate with live history.

rules.LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY: PRICE-GATED ONLY: tona_minus_ioer_bps ≥ STRESS persistent AND (clf_loans_daily > 0 two sessions OR gc_minus_ioer_bps ≥ STRESS); quantity anchors are dead-man switches — kept in the enum for cross-currency comparability (CodeWord/Perplexity)
rules.FLOOR_FRICTION: reserves ample AND friction_confirmed (TONA at/above IOER 3 sessions, or high ≥ IOER+5 3 sessions)
rules.LIQUIDITY_DRAIN: general regime: central bank AND treasury both DRAIN, or dual-weighted score ≤ drain threshold (regime.dual)
rules.LIQUIDITY_INJECTION: general regime: both INJECTION, or dual-weighted score ≥ injection threshold (regime.dual)
rules.NEUTRAL: otherwise (including unresolved conflicts inside the thresholds)

orthogonal_flags.FX_INTERVENTION_SUSPECT: daily: fiscal_flow_daily negative outlier |z| ≥ 3 with no auction settlement/tax date; monthly confirmation: FEFSA receipts ≥ 3x prior year (MoF Excel) or MASDM26 outlier
orthogonal_flags.BOJ_CREDIT_DEPENDENCE_ELEVATED: boj_credit_dependence ≥ p80 → _STRESS if tona_minus_ioer_bps ≥ WATCH else _HEALTHY
orthogonal_flags.DATA_DEGRADED: quality < 70 or reconciliation cab_dod vs cab_net_change_daily fails
orthogonal_flags.SUPER_LONG_TAIL: fiscal.auction_tail_superlong_bp level >= WATCH (tail ≥ 3 bp or ≥ p85 of 36 auctions)
orthogonal_flags.SUPER_LONG_SUPPLY_AHEAD: 20Y/30Y/40Y auction within 3 days of as-of (supply event)

calibration.note: percentile windows anchored at 2024-08-01 (= second hike + start of the JGB-purchase reduction plan; NOT the first hike — that was 2024-03-19, end of NIRP/YCC); daily factor series (fiscal, SLF, CLF, banknotes) only exist as XLSX since 2025-10-06 (~330 sessions) — their real window is shorter than 750d; min_n guard: daily 120, ten_day 30, monthly 12

QT_STRESS.note: overlay on top of the regime (not in the enum): JPY stress lives in collateral and the super-long curve, not in reserve quantity (all reviewers); SLF 'STRESS' here = p95+ because slf percentile watch is p95

dual.status: calibrated by replay 2026-09-09 (engine v0.3, era 2024-07-31, 102 weeks)

central_bank.rule: era p80/p20 (exit p67/p33) of the 7-day mean score, nearest attainable, exit after 0 days inside

fiscal.rule: era p80/p20 (exit p67/p33) of the 7-day mean score, nearest attainable, exit after 0 days inside

dual.rule: three regimes per currency (engine v0.3): central_bank and fiscal from their block score with era-calibrated entry/exit cuts on the 7-day mean score; general = agreement only (both inject → LIQUIDITY_INJECTION, both drain → LIQUIDITY_DRAIN, partial or conflict → NEUTRAL labelled); percentile windows anchored to era_start; price gates (LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY, FLOOR_FRICTION) override the general regime

regime.composite_note: weights (4 blocks) now produce the desk composite score for context; the reported regime is the general regime (central bank + treasury)

dual_v02.rule: three regimes per currency: central_bank (block score), fiscal (block score), general = agreement (both inject → LIQUIDITY_INJECTION, both drain → LIQUIDITY_DRAIN); a conflict is resolved by the dual-weighted score against general_thresholds; price gates (LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY, FLOOR_FRICTION) override the general regime

status_rules.note: ten_day = 10-day data + 2-3 business-day publication lag; daily=4 covers weekends and Japanese holidays; thin term-call series allowed stale 10 sessions

quality.null_policy: null is NEVER neutral: series -> unavailable; empty facility cells in the daily file = 0 with last-use memo (AUD rule)

revisions.note: provisional (jx) → final (jd) revision tracked per date

alerts.note: rule grammar (engine): 'level >= X' | '> n' | 'abs >= n' | '<= drain' | '<= risk_off' | quality.<field>; fx_intervention_suspect boolean → value True > 0
